title: Analyze the RFP
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Analyze the synthetic Meridian Healthcare RFP and show the traceable requirement checklist.

answer.question: Analyze the synthetic Meridian Healthcare RFP and show the traceable requirement checklist.
answer.answer:
Here's the traceable requirement checklist for **Meridian Healthcare** (RFP-2024-0147, $1.2M, overall fit 95.7%):

| ID | Requirement | Category | Weight | Fit | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | EHR integration | Technical | 25% | 95% | Native Epic & Cerner connectors, certified |
| R2 | HIPAA compliance | Compliance | 25% | 100% | SOC 2 Type II + HIPAA certified |
| R3 | 24/7 support | Support | 15% | 98% | 24/7/365, 15-min response SLA |
| R4 | 16-week implementation | Delivery | 20% | 92% | 12-week methodology + accelerators |
| R5 | Training | Training | 15% | 92% | Role-based curriculum with certification |

I also compiled the full draft package (38 pages: exec summary, architecture, implementation plan, pricing $1.18M, 3 references, HIPAA/SOC 2 docs). It still needs **legal review, pricing approval, and branding check** before anything goes to CIO Amanda Foster — nothing's been sent.

Want the delivery readiness summary next?
